visual_requirements.description: Plain female human editorial rendering of Iranian goddess; no sourced body specification, costume or iconography asserted, fully opaque clothing.
Unspecified shrine beside a naturally flowing stream.
Dove and peacock as sacred associated animals, kept secondary to the goddess.

prompts.A:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of ANAHITA, an Iranian goddess with sacred dove and peacock, at her waterside shrine.
ANATOMY: plain adult female human editorial rendering with one head, two eyes, two arms, two legs, unadorned fully opaque heavy layered woven clothing. No appearance or dress iconography is documented, so no crown, jewelry symbols, weapons or sacred equipment. One realistic dove and one realistic peacock are her associated sacred animals, secondary to her body. [anahita-c01, anahita-c06]
MOMENT: advancing decisively toward the viewer from the dark shrine threshold beside a stream, bending her near shoulder forward and turning her intense gaze directly downward at the camera; one empty open hand held close beside her chest. The dove takes ordinary physical flight beside her shoulder; the peacock stays near the threshold.
POWER: no documented magical effect or elemental control; the stream flows naturally. Awe arises from an overwhelming close approach, sacred animal association, natural backlighting and the documented sacred setting. [anahita-c05, anahita-c06]
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low angle tight upper-body composition, face and moving shoulders fill most of the square; normal bodily scale, no tiny humans or size claims; birds visibly secondary, never a bird picture with a woman small behind.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one strong low amber sunset shaft crossing the shrine entrance, natural rim on cloth and bird feathers, deep walnut shadows, ordinary stream spray below the frame.
SURFACE: dense opaque textured fabric, damp rough stone, delicate dove feathers and tactile peacock feathers, rich painterly realism.
SETTING: an unspecified simple dark shrine beside a stream, no invented historic architecture or script. [anahita-c05]
MOOD: reverent, awe-inspiring and overwhelming, imposing calm authority in physical movement; never monstrous, smiling, cute, decorative or an ordinary human portrait.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, logo, border, frame or watermark; one head, two eyes, two arms, two legs, normal five-finger human hands; no extra limbs; no design borrowed from any film, game, anime or comic; fully opaque layered clothing, no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline, energy ribbons, weapons, crown, horns, animal transformation, magical body or invented sacred iconography.
prompts.B:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of ANAHITA, Iranian goddess at a shrine beside running water, accompanied by her sacred dove and peacock.
ANATOMY: a plain adult female human editorial rendering, one head, two eyes, two arms, two legs, entirely covered by unadorned opaque heavy woven layers; bodily appearance and garment are editorial, no historically asserted attributes. One dove and one peacock are secondary sacred associated animals. [anahita-c01, anahita-c06]
MOMENT: turning in a forceful sweeping step at the waterside shrine threshold, body angled across the frame while her face turns downward toward the viewer; both empty hands close to her own body, her moving opaque cloth creates a strong diagonal. A dove flies normally behind her raised shoulder, the peacock moves beside her lower robe.
POWER: no hydrokinesis, no supernatural water, no magical radiance; water courses naturally downhill beside the shrine. Awe comes from the documented goddess and sacred animals, dramatic bodily movement and low viewpoint. [anahita-c05, anahita-c06]
SCALE & CAMERA: oblique extreme low angle, compressed nearly full-body framing with foreshortened near shoulder, head and face large and immediately legible; subject fills almost the entire square, no tiny people or implied gigantic size.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one warm slant of late sunlight across the stream and silhouette, deep dark walnut shadows, ordinary natural splashes from running water at the edge.
SURFACE: textured dense fabric, wet plain stone, detailed bird feathers, painterly cinematic realism.
SETTING: deliberately unspecified waterside shrine entrance and natural rocky watercourse, no decorative cult objects or invented architecture. [anahita-c05]
MOOD: respectful, commanding, awe-inspiring and overwhelming, active rather than neutral; no frightening monstrosity, no decorative portrait or ordinary passer-by.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, logo, border, frame or watermark; one head, two eyes, two arms, two legs, normal five-finger human hands; no extra limbs; no design borrowed from any film, game, anime or comic; fully opaque layered clothing, no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline, energy ribbons, weapons, crown, horns, animal transformation, magical body or invented sacred iconography.
